hero.title: Give every job posting a clear risk basis.
hero.description: Connect deterministic rules, traceable evidence and human review in one controlled workflow, so platforms and employers can identify hiring compliance risk earlier.
hero.note: An audit assistant, not a legal adjudicator. Insufficient evidence is routed to human review.

features.title: Turn audit decisions into an executable, traceable workflow.

items.title: Rule-driven audit
items.description: YAML-configured deterministic rules identify discrimination, fees, privacy and misleading-risk signals first.

items.title: Evidence and explanation
items.description: Each finding can link to a rule, law or platform reference so reviewers can verify it quickly.

items.title: Human-in-the-loop
items.description: High-risk and insufficient-evidence cases route to human review; feedback improves evals and rule operations.

items.title: Controlled operations
items.description: Versions, evaluations, rollout, alerts and rollback keep rule updates verifiable and auditable.

howItWorks.title: From job text to an explainable audit report.

steps.title: Send a job posting
steps.description: Submit text and structured fields from the console or REST API.

steps.title: Verify rules and evidence
steps.description: The rule engine identifies signals first; knowledge retrieval adds traceable references.

steps.title: Aggregate risk
steps.description: Combine risk level, suggested action and rewrite guidance, then validate output quality.

steps.title: Review and learn
steps.description: Route cases to humans when needed; feedback informs evaluation sets and rules.

useCases.title: One consistent compliance language for every hiring workflow.

items.title: Pre-publication platform review
items.description: Identify explicit risk before posting and route ambiguous cases to reviewers.

items.title: Employer content self-check
items.description: Help recruiting teams understand risk sources and apply explainable changes before resubmission.

items.title: Compliance operations
items.description: Govern rule and knowledge changes with evals, red-team testing, rollout and release gates.

security.title: An audit operating model designed for sensitive hiring data.
security.description: Sensitive information is redacted by default before audit logging and LLM input, while versions, evidence and operations remain traceable.
items: Traceable rule, knowledge-base and model versions

api.title: Connect existing hiring flows with stable REST APIs.
api.description: Supports single and batch audits, webhook callbacks, report exports and Sandbox trials.

pricing.title: Start with a controlled trial and scale by audit volume.
pricing.description: Free Trial, Starter, Pro and Enterprise are configured around pilot scope and integration needs.
pricing.note: Pricing and enterprise SLAs are provided in a formal quote.

request.title: Ready to connect compliance review to your workflow?
request.description: Leave a work contact and we will arrange a controlled demo or Sandbox setup for your use case.
request.privacyNote: We retain only a redacted contact value and hash for de-duplication and follow-up; the full email is not stored here.
request.success: We received your request and will be in touch soon.
request.error: Submission failed. Check that the API is available and try again.

footer.disclaimer: This product assists with hiring-compliance risk and is not legal advice or legal adjudication.

apiPortal.title: Hiring Compliance Audit API
apiPortal.description: Use stable APIs for job audits, batch processing, usage checks and audit-report exports.
apiPortal.authenticationDescription: Include a tenant-issued API Key in request headers. Use and store keys only in server-side environments.
apiPortal.sdkDescription: Use native fetch today; a packaged SDK will be available with the production product release.
apiPortal.sandboxDescription: Sandbox uses simulated data and isolated quota, suited to field mapping, webhook and audit-result consumer validation.
apiPortal.footer: API enum values remain stable; client applications localize their display labels.

permissions.noAccessTitle: This role cannot access this page
permissions.noAccessDescription: Switch to a role with the required permission, or return to the Dashboard to see available workspaces. Backend APIs still enforce authorization.

sensitiveAction.publishDescription: After publishing, the new rule version may affect future job audit decisions.
sensitiveAction.forcePublishDescription: Force publish bypasses normal quality gate restrictions and should only be used when risk is accepted by a compliance manager.
sensitiveAction.rollbackDescription: Rollback switches online rules back to the previous stable version to handle false positives, missed risks or abnormal metrics.
sensitiveAction.evalImpact: Eval / red team checks should already be completed
sensitiveAction.rollbackImpact: Will restore the previous published version
sensitiveAction.auditImpact: Future auditRun records will use the rolled-back ruleVersion
sensitiveAction.releasePublishDescription: Publishing creates rollout plans and binds the selected rule, law KB, model or prompt version.
sensitiveAction.rolloutCreateDescription: The rollout plan affects version selection for selected tenants or percentage traffic. Confirm stable and candidate versions before continuing.
sensitiveAction.rolloutRollbackDescription: Rollback switches this rollout plan back to stableVersion to handle abnormal metrics or quality issues.
sensitiveAction.humanDecisionDescription: The human decision updates review ticket status and may feed eval sets or rule improvement suggestions.

appeals.emptyDescription: Appeal backend capability is available. Productized pages can later show employer appeals, supplementary notes and re-review reports here.
